text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I really need to cut back on 
meat...
choice_data_list: Are you trying to cut weight?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I found this really, really 
tasty animal-based protein drink 
recently...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've been eating such an unbalanced diet 
lately, and now... my skin is breaking 
out...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I wanted to eat lots of 
vegetables and get just a little bit 
prettier..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, not that someone like me really 
has any business talking about wanting to 
become pretty or anything! Ahaha...!

Mejiro Ryan seemed to be troubled by rough 
skin...
